Package mayhemlib.recovery

Class BeachDetector

java.lang.Object
mayhemlib.recovery.BeachDetector
public final class BeachDetector extends Object
Decides when the robot is beached (sitting tilted on fuel) from IMU pitch and roll, and which way is downhill.

Angles follow the CTRE Pigeon 2 convention (X forward, Y left, Z up, right-hand rule): positive pitch is nose down, positive roll is left side up.
